metaDescription: Shop custom 4XLarge outdoor blankets for events, sports, and picnics. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 4XLarge outdoor blankets offer generous space for groups at concerts, sporting events, or corporate picnics. Sized to seat 4–6 people comfortably, these oversized blankets provide a premium canvas for screen-printed or embroidered logos. Choose from fleece, plaid, or sand-repellent options to match your brand's style and audience needs.
